## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` (zero warnings) and `npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage` passes and core coverage stays ≥ 80 %
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes (or explain why it does not apply)
- [ ] Rust checks pass if `src-tauri/` changed (`fmt`, `clippy -D warnings`, `test`)
- [ ] Version in `package.json`, `Cargo.toml` and `tauri.conf.json` still in sync
- [ ] No new network access at runtime; CSP unchanged or justified in `docs/DECISIONS.md`
- [ ] Accessibility considered (labels, keyboard, contrast, reduced motion)
- [ ] Documentation updated (`README`, `docs/*`, `CHANGELOG.md`)
